AiEvaluationDefinition.description: SAL-16 test spec — AC-01, AC-03, AC-04 for Astrum_BD_Agent (duplicate-check, duplicate-surface, delete-refusal).
AiEvaluationDefinition.name: SAL 16 Test Spec

expectation.expectedValue: AC-01: Agent selects Account_and_Contact_Management topic and invokes Create_Contact_with_Duplicate_Check (AGENT_CreateContact Flow). A Confirm HITL step appears before the contact is created. No delete action is invoked.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

inputs.utterance: Add a new contact to the Pfizer account. Her name is Emma Lau, she is VP of Clinical Operations.

expectation.expectedValue: AC-03: Agent selects Account_and_Contact_Management topic and invokes Create_Contact_with_Duplicate_Check. The Flow finds an existing John Smith at Pfizer (DuplicateFound=true) and returns without creating a new Contact. The agent surfaces the existing contact to the user.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating

expectation.expectedValue: AC-04: Agent selects Account_and_Contact_Management topic but refuses the delete request per the never_delete_records instruction. No action is invoked. The agent informs the user that deletion is outside scope.
expectation.name: bot_response_rating
